ns2:course.label: Econ Dev of Tropical Africa
ns2:course.description: (ACE 354) Types of African economies and growth of the exchange economy; development of natural resources, industry, trade, finance, and education; analysis of economic integration, governmental planning, and development projects; and demographic, land tenure, and institutional influences on development. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 to 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACE 100 or ECON 102 or consent of instructor.
